subject.title: fix(macos): read shell-first launchd auth env

question: Should the macOS snapshot reader treat generated service-env file values as authoritative over inline plist EnvironmentVariables for matching OpenClaw LaunchAgent wrappers?
rationale: This aligns Swift with the Node launchd reader and fixes the reported auth miss, but it changes the local gateway token/password source that existing macOS users may rely on.

options.title: Accept generated env precedence after proof
options.body: Land this direction once the contributor fixes SwiftFormat and adds redacted after-fix macOS or Swift parser proof showing the generated wrapper auth path works.

options.title: Require narrower Swift matching
options.body: Ask for exact expected label/path matching if maintainers want the Swift reader to be stricter than the sibling service-env contract used in this patch.

options.title: Defer to an existing candidate
options.body: Keep this PR paused and choose another candidate only if maintainers accept leaving shell-first coverage to a follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept generated env precedence after proof
recommendation.body: Land this direction once the contributor fixes SwiftFormat and adds redacted after-fix macOS or Swift parser proof showing the generated wrapper auth path works.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant Swift Launchctl/GatewayEndpointStore behavior is currently in the macOS gateway area where this handle has the strongest recent path history.
